current_trust_model_unchanged: leaf SHA-256 pinning plus DER validity window plus SAN host name matching. There is still no path building to a trusted root, because the library cannot perform it

finding.description: CERT_PKIXVerifyCert returns SECFailure with PR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED in the pinned Firefox 159 NSS 3.131 build, with a real read-write cert database initialised

options_for_a_future_round: build NSS with the PKIX verifier enabled and re-verify the same fixture
implement RFC 5280 path building and signature verification outside NSS, which means writing certificate path validation by hand
switch the trust model to explicit leaf pinning as a documented product decision rather than an unimplemented aspiration
what_was_attempted: wrote a standalone NSS PKIX helper using cert_pi_trustAnchors with useOnlyTrustAnchors=TRUE and AIA fetch disabled
initialised NSS with NSS_InitReadWrite on a throwaway database because NSS_NoDB_Init left the handle unusable
built a real CA and leaf fixture (CA:TRUE with keyCertSign, leaf with SAN DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1) and confirmed openssl accepts it
surfaced the NSS error text rather than a numeric code so the failure is diagnosable
why_it_fails: the PKIX engine is not compiled into this NSS build; the exported symbol exists but its implementation returns PR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, so no anchor, chain or host name can change the result
